title: Pilot direct backend handler and narrow UI component tests on one dashboard family

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — verdict: Caught

Story: .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#pilot-direct-dashboard-unit-tests (plan .planning/slice-plans/720-pilot-direct-dashboard-unit-tests/PLAN.md, slice 3). Revision: 6723c8e2c2d65e78fa11aad404c69660030f5633.

Promise: a started server refuses a `PUT`, an extra-field body and a foreign origin on the notes endpoint (405, 400, 403) and writes no notes file.

Fault chosen (validated): in the wire adapter `answerStoryNotes` (dashboard/server/storyNotes.ts), the method guard changed from
  `if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "POST")`
to
  `if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "PUT")`.
I checked that the endpoint reaches this adapter directly from projectConfigurationBoundary.ts (`pathname === storyNotesEndpoint`) with no earlier method filter, so a `PUT` falls through to change parsing and `storyNotes(project, change)`, which saves the note. I used the suggested `PUT` fault rather than loosening the schema because it targets the one rejection that was not scratch-broken during execution. No fixture was used, and assertions were left unchanged.

Maintained check examined: dashboard/backend-tests/review/story-notes-admission.spec.ts, the test "Given a started dashboard, when notes requests are misdirected, malformed or foreign, …", step "When another method is used, then it is not allowed", assertion `expect(response.status(), method).toBe(405)` (line 66).

Runs (isolated detached scratch worktree at the revision, with `npm ci` on Node 24.21.0; command `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_PROOF_RECORD=<file> npm run test:dashboard:backend -- review/story-notes`):
- Baseline: exit 0. The proof record shows phase completed and 10 selected tests (the admission spec on Playwright plus 9 unit tests on Vitest), all passing. The admission spec ran its single attempt and passed in 324 ms, so reach is confirmed.
- Faulted: exit 1. The admission spec failed with message "PUT", Expected 405, Received 200, at line 66. The other 9 unit tests passed. The 200 response to a `PUT` carrying a valid add body is the wrong behavior, observed directly on the intended path: the server accepted the `PUT` as a change instead of refusing it. Under this fault code the only way to get a 200 for a non-GET request is to run the change through the store.
- Restored: the edit was undone by a trap-protected copy. `git diff --quiet HEAD` was clean and `git status` empty, matching the clean pre-probe state. Rerunning the same command gave exit 0 with all 10 tests passing.
Limit of the claim: this catch covers only the `PUT` refusal path. The extra-field 400 and the "no notes file" check were not faulted in this probe. In the faulted run the no-file assertion was never reached because the test stopped at the earlier step.

Next proof action: none is required for the `PUT` refusal. If more confidence is wanted, probe the extra-field (strict schema) rejection on its own.
Prior disposition: this complements execution's scratch break of the 403 expectation. No new repair decision follows from this probe.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured from the Vitest summary Duration of the focused command: baseline 414 ms, faulted 282 ms, restored 255 ms. Measured baseline wall clock including the Playwright server startup was about 6 s. The faulted and restored wall clocks were not separately timed and are estimated at about 6 s each.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part in this probe, and no separate measure exists.
- Agent effort: unavailable. This agent has no separately supported token or time measure. Its tool calls numbered about 8 (estimated count, not a cost measure).


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 63536 ms (measured), from 1795092758000 to 1795092821536 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Checked revision `6723c8e2c2d65e78fa11aad404c69660030f5633`, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
